mcqs.q: What is the difference between OR and XOR?
options: They are the same gate with different names.
O(1) - because it is fast.
OR is true when at least one input is true; XOR is true when exactly one input is true.
OR is for numbers, XOR is for letters.

mcqs.q: What is the denary value of binary 10110?
options: O(1) - because it is fast.
11 (counting the 1s).
10110 (treating it as a denary number).

mcqs.q: What is the time complexity of binary search?
options: O(log n).
OR is for numbers, XOR is for letters.
O(1) - because it is fast.
O(n) - because it searches through items.

mcqs.q: Which of these is the best definition of “XOR”?
options: Output 1 if inputs differ.
A value that is True (1) or False (0).
Output 1 only if both inputs are 1.
Inverts the input: 0 becomes 1, 1 becomes 0.

mcqs.q: Which of these is the best definition of “OR”?
options: Output 1 only if both inputs are 1.
Output 1 if at least one input is 1.
A value that is True (1) or False (0).
Output 1 if inputs differ.

mcqs.q: Which of these is the best definition of “Truth table”?
options: Lists every possible input and its output.
Output 1 if inputs differ.
Output 1 if at least one input is 1.
Inverts the input: 0 becomes 1, 1 becomes 0.

mcqs.q: Which of these is the best definition of “NOT”?
options: Inverts the input: 0 becomes 1, 1 becomes 0.
Lists every possible input and its output.
Output 1 only if both inputs are 1.
Output 1 if at least one input is 1.

mcqs.q: Which of these is the best definition of “Boolean”?
options: Output 1 if at least one input is 1.
A value that is True (1) or False (0).
Lists every possible input and its output.
Output 1 if inputs differ.

mcqs.q: Which of these is the best definition of “AND”?
options: A value that is True (1) or False (0).
Output 1 only if both inputs are 1.
Output 1 if at least one input is 1.
Output 1 if inputs differ.
